sections.A: Hip ek ball-and-socket jor hai jis ke kinare par labrum hota hai. FAI mein ball ya socket ki shakal (cam ya pincer) se gehri movement par takkar hoti hai, aur labrum zakhmi ho sakta hai.
sections.B: Groin mein dard, kabhi hip ke bahar ya kooleh mein, gehre jhukne, mudne, der tak baithne ya gaari se utarne par.
sections.C: Dard kahan hai (haath se dikhayein), kaun si positions dard deti hain, aur kya clicking ya atakna hai.
sections.D: Chaal, hip ki range (flexion, rotation) aur taaqat dekhein.
sections.E: Koi test FAI ya labral tear confirm nahi karta. FADIR jaise tests aksar positive aate hain lekin specific nahi; negative test zyada madadgar hai.
sections.F: Hip OA, gluteal tendinopathy, groin strain aur kamar se aata dard isi jaise lag sakte hain.
sections.G: Langrata naujawan aur hip rotation dard wali ya kam (growth plate ka masla), ya runner mein impact se dard (stress fracture): urgent refer.
sections.H: Red flags na hon, movement ya position se groin dard, positive tests aur imaging mein shakal ki tabdeeli: FAI syndrome.
sections.I: Hip flexors, adductors aur gluteals par soft tissue kaam, aur hip mobilisation exercise ko aasaan banane ke liye.
sections.J: Supervised, dheere dheere barhta hip aur trunk strengthening, movement control aur dard wali positions kam karna.
sections.L: Naujawanon mein flags screen karein, FAI ko shakal aur load ka masla samjhayein, 3 mahine exercise, phir zaroorat ho to surgeon.
sections.M: Dard, iHOT-12 ya HOOS, FADIR, hip flexion aur rotation, aur taaqat dobara dekhein.
sections.N: 28 saal ke footballer ko gehre squat aur gaari se utarne par groin dard hai. Khud socho, phir jawab dekho.
sections.chapter-summary-treatment-decision: Mukhtasar: flags screen karein, phir education, kaam mein tabdeeli aur exercise.
sections.now-you-should-be-able-to: Yeh checklist hai. Har point khud kar sakein to tick karein.
